
            <h1 class="postTitle">
                <a id="cb_post_title_url" class="postTitle2 vertical-middle" href="https://www.cnblogs.com/tianqing/p/19622981" title="发布于 2026-02-23 09:56">
    <span role="heading" aria-level="2">.NET 10 &amp; C# 14 New Features 新增功能介绍-field关键字</span>
    

</a>

            </h1>
            <div class="clear"></div>
            <div class="postBody">
                <div id="cnblogs_post_body" class="blogpost-body blogpost-body-html">
<p>上篇文章给大家分享了<br><a class="postTitle2 vertical-middle" href="https://www.cnblogs.com/tianqing/p/19622970">.NET 10 &amp; C# 14 New Features 新增功能介绍-扩展成员Extension Members</a></p>
<p>今天给大家继续分享field关键字</p>
<p class="p1">在 <span class="s1"><strong>C# 14</strong> 中，引入了新的上下文关键字 <span class="s1"><strong>field</strong>，用于在<span class="s1"><strong>自动属性（auto-property）的访问器中</strong>直接访问编译器生成的隐藏 backing field（后备字段）。</span></span></span></p>
<p class="p2">这解决了一个长期存在的问题：</p>
<blockquote>自动属性如果需要在 <span class="s1">set 中做校验或增强逻辑，就必须手动声明一个私有字段。</span></blockquote>
<p class="p1"><span class="s1">主要价值：field 允许你在属性的 <span class="s1">get / <span class="s1">set 访问器内部，直接访问自动生成的隐藏字段，而不需要手写私有变量。</span></span></span></p>
<p class="p1"><strong><span class="s1" style="font-size: 16px">一、代码示例</span></strong></p>
<p class="p1"><span class="s1">① 传统写法：</span></p>
<p class="p1">需要手动声明 <span class="s1">_age。</span></p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">private</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">int</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> _age;

</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">public</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">int</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> Age
{
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">get</span> =&gt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> _age;
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">set</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
    {
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span> (value &lt; <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">0</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)
            </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">throw</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> ArgumentException();
        _age </span>=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> value;
    }
}</span></pre>
</div>
<p>② 使用filed关键字</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">public</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">int</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> Age
{
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">get</span> =&gt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> field;
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">set</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
    {
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span> (value &lt; <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">0</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)
            </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">throw</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> ArgumentException();
        field </span>=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> value;
    }
}</span></pre>
</div>
<p class="p1">这个语法糖：</p>
<ul>
<li class="p1">不需要声明 <span class="s1">_age</span></li>
<li class="p1">语义更清晰</li>
<li class="p1">减少样板代码</li>
</ul>
<p><strong><span style="font-size: 16px">二、典型应用场景</span></strong></p>
<p class="p1">&nbsp;<strong><span class="Apple-converted-space">&nbsp;带校验的自动属性</span></strong></p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">public</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">string</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> Name
{
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">get</span> =&gt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> field;
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">set</span> =&gt; field = <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">string</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(value)
        </span>? <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">throw</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span> ArgumentException(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">Name cannot be empty</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)
        : value;
}</span></pre>
</div>
<p>&nbsp;<strong>修改值后做额外处理</strong></p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">public</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">int</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> Score
{
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">get</span> =&gt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> field;
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">set</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
    {
        field </span>=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> value;
        OnScoreChanged();
    }
}</span></pre>
</div>
<p class="p1">&nbsp;<strong>限制最大最小值</strong></p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">public</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">int</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> Percentage
{
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">get</span> =&gt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> field;
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">set</span> =&gt; field = Math.Clamp(value, <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">0</span>, <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">100</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">);
}</span></pre>
</div>
<p><strong><span style="font-size: 16px">三、底层技术原理</span></strong></p>
<p class="p1">编译器仍然生成类似：</p>
<p class="p1">private int &lt;Age&gt;k__BackingField;</p>
<p class="p1"><span class="s1">field 本质是对这个隐藏字段的语法糖访问。</span></p>
<p class="p3"><strong>IL 不变，只有语法层增强。</strong></p>
<p class="p1"><span class="s1">field 关键字本质是：</span></p>
<blockquote>让自动属性可以“半升级”为带逻辑的属性，而不丢失简洁性。</blockquote>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p>以上分享给大家。</p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p>周国庆</p>
